I am an old man now, 68 years, and this small plot of beans I keep close to the house. Beans do not need the fertilizer like maize does — they find their own nitrogen from the soil, so I will not waste my coupons on this plot even if I get them. I will plant the seeds I saved from last harvest, as we always do, and since I am intercropping I must weed carefully by hand. My sons help sometimes but mostly it is my own two hands on this small piece of land.
